QuestInfo.name: Frontier Collector
QuestInfo.0: A new continent's been discovered! Go get some details.
QuestInfo.1: There's a rumor going around that a new continent was found to the south of Ossyria. Maybe that's where all these mysterious items have been coming from? Collect rare items from monsters and become a collector!\r\n#y17220:##b #R17220##k/10
QuestInfo.2: You loaded up on rare items! You've got plenty of collector cred now!

0.0: Hello, #h0#. Have you heard about the newly-discovered continent? All the collectors are itching to collect new and rare items from this mysterious land. Do you have any interest in those items, #h0#? I heard that Cassandra is looking for them already. Will you go help her?

yes.0: Help her 10 times and I will recognize your rare collecting skills.

1.0: I've spoken with Cassandra. You've helped her greatly. I think you have a knack for collecting things.

yes.0: I think that title is perfect for you.
